headline: Congress named a Saipan post office building after Segundo T. Sablan and the Northern Mariana Islands' fallen military heroes.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Chalan Kanoa on Saipan, in the Northern Mariana Islands. The building will now be called the Segundo T. Sablan and CNMI Fallen Military Heroes Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
